page.text: Brightwater Ironbridge Director - RFP Leader Who are we? Elmstone Harbourline is a collective – a group of talented and passionate people all around the world. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no-limits mindset, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 18,000 employees spanning over 100 countries. People join Elmstone Harbourline for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down headhunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work / life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like-minded people driving change at Elmstone Harbourline. Working at Elmstone Harbourline Re At Elmstone Harbourline Re, we’re on a mission to do things differently. Our no silo approach, elite team, and clear focus on innovation and relentless execution means our clients are at the heart of all we do. As a big 4 global reinsurance broker, we deliberately avoid the one-size-fits-all approach, committing to creating bespoke solutions that address the unique challenges of a modern and dynamic marketplace. Our team is empowered to drive progress, creating opportunities for career and personal development, unlocking new value for clients, fostering long-term partnerships, and using the collective power of Elmstone Harbourline to change how the world sees risk and insurance. When you join Elmstone Harbourline Re, you become part of a vibrant and entrepreneurial workplace culture that prioritises collaboration, ownership, and shared success. Here, your contributions will directly impact our mission to be the global partner of choice in reinsurance and strategic advisory. Be a part of Elmstone Harbourline Re's exciting journey. Together, we are shaping the future of reinsurance. What are we looking for? Are you a visionary leader and seeking to build a team from the ground up? Have you held a senior RFP role in the (Re)Insurance sector ? We’re on the lookout for someone to bring this to life through our RFP process. This is a global role and an incredibly exciting opportunity for someone with a passion for winning, and the leadership and vision to build an exciting and compelling RFP process and proposition. In the role you will work closely with colleagues across the business and with our Markets and Marketing teams to really bring the best of Elmstone Harbourline Re together. What are the main responsibilities: Development of a clear RFP process and governance framework Accountable for the identification, capture, management and triaging of all relevant opportunities Influencing cross functional stakeholders to determine bid / no-bid decisions and the strategic fit and tender response proposition for opportunities Project management of RFP responses, from pre-invitation through to post-decision, in close collaboration with broking account executives, to ultimately maximise case by case probabilities and ensure widespread adoption of best practice The creation of high-quality RFP collateral, including the development of a best-in-class RFP library Designing and implementing a post-tender review process for wins and losses, capturing key learnings to enable continuous improvement Implementation of technology to drive innovation across the RFP process Development of a team (in-house and outsourced as needed) to ensure exceptional design, proof reading, storytelling and project management capabilities. page.text: Brightwater Ironbridge Senior Marketing Manager - Financial Lines Who are we? Elmstone Harbourline is a global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no-limits mindset, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 24,000 employees spanning over 56 countries. People join Elmstone Harbourline for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down headhunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work / life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like-minded people driving change at Elmstone Harbourline. The Role We’re looking for an experienced , creative and commercially minded Senior Marketing Manager to help drive the continued growth of two of Elmstone Harbourline’s most established and exciting practices : Financial Institutions and Directors & Officers (D&O) . D&O has a special place in Elmstone Harbourline’s story too - the very first insurance policy bound by our founder , David Elmstone Harbourline , was a D &O policy . This is a brilliant opportunity to work at the heart of two complementary specialty businesses , shaping strategic marketing and communications programmes that elevate market profile, deepen client relationships and help unlock growth. You’ll be a trusted partner to senior stakeholders - getting under the skin of their prio rities , spotting opportunities and turning business ambition into creative, e ffective marketing and communications activity . You’ll also lead and develop a team of two marketing professionals, giving them the guidance, energy and support they need to do great work and keep growing. You’ll join a marketing team where culture really matters. We’d describe ourselves as friendly, supportive and energetic - a team with a strong work ethic, plenty of personality and a genuine focus on balance, wellbeing and enjoying what we do. We take development seriously, with regular training, coaching and 1-1s to help people build confidence and progress. We also make time to connect as a team , with socials throughout the year - from our annual sports day to monthly book club. We’re predominantly office-based ( at least three days a week ) to support collaboration , connection and momentum - balanced with regular flexibility to work from home . What you'll be doing Shape and deliver the marketing strategy for the Financial Institutions and D&O practices in close partnership with business leadership. Partner with senior stakeholders as a strategic marketing adviser, translating commercial priorities into high-impact activity. Create compelling value propositions, thought leadership and market-facing communications that bring the practices’ expertise to life. Lead integrated, multi-channel campaigns across digital, social media, email, events, PR and content marketing. Craft engaging communications for internal and external audiences, with clear, consistent messaging and a strong brand voice. Work with subject matter experts to turn insight and expertise into content that strengthens market positioning and client engagement. Lead, coach and develop a team of two, creating the clarity, confidence and momentum they need to perform at their best. Build strong connections across the wider Specialty marketing team and international marketing network to spark ideas, share best practice and create opportunities for collaboration. Title: Senior DevSecOps Cybersecurity Engineer Belong. Connect. Grow. with KBR! KBR’s National Security Solutions team provides high-end engineering and advanced technology solutions to our customers in the intelligence and national security communities. In this position, your work will have a profound impact on the country’s most critical role – protecting our national security. KBR is seeking a motivated and experienced Senior DevSecOps Cybersecurity Engineer to join our team. The primary work location is remote. This role serves as a senior cybersecurity practitioner embedded within Agile and DevSecOps development teams responsible for delivering capabilities into government-owned production environments operating at IL5 and IL6. The Cybersecurity Engineer will work closely with software developers, cloud engineers, mission owners, systems engineers, Information System Security Managers (ISSMs), Authorizing Officials (AOs), and government cybersecurity personnel to ensure software releases meet security, compliance, and operational requirements. The position requires deep expertise in RMF implementation, vulnerability management, CVE assessment and remediation, secure deployment methodologies, and cybersecurity activities necessary to support Authority to Operate (ATO) accredited environments. The successful candidate must be capable of explaining cybersecurity risk to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, developing mitigation strategies for identified vulnerabilities, and ensuring mission capabilities can be rapidly and securely deployed into operational environments. This role is a senior cybersecurity and RMF expert embedded within DevSecOps software delivery teams responsible for enabling secure deployment of mission capabilities into accredited IL5 and IL6 production environments. The emphasis is on CVE analysis and remediation, RMF execution, cybersecurity documentation, deployment approval activities, security compliance, and effective communication of cyber risk to government stakeholders while enabling rapid and secure mission capability delivery. KBR (formerly LinQuest) is the prime contractor on the Military Satellite Communications (MILSATCOM) Systems Engineering, Integration and Test (MSEIT) contract. The MSEIT effort provides leading-edge Systems Engineering & Integration (SE&I) for the United States Space Force’s (USSF) Space Systems Command (SSC). We acquire state-of-the-art Military and Commercial Satellite Communications (SATCOM) systems, providing global, secure, survivable, and protected communications for our nation’s warfighters. We seek technical individuals who will thrive in a highly collaborative work environment of small teams, using the most modern tools and methodologies to tackle the challenges of integrating complex space and ground communications systems. Why Join Us? Innovative Projects: KBR’s work is at the forefront of engineering, logistics, operations, science, program management, mission IT and cybersecurity solutions. Collaborative Environment: Be part of a dynamic team that thrives on collaboration and innovation, fostering a supportive and intellectually stimulating workplace. Impactful Work: Your contributions will be pivotal in designing and optimizing defense systems that ensure national security and shape the future of space defense. Title: Administrative Support Specialist KBR is seeking an Administrative Support Specialist (Evening Shift: 1–9 PM) to support student management and accountability operations at SWESC/Naval Station Great Lakes (NORTH CHICAGO). This is a full-time, onsite role where you’ll help keep day-to-day operations running smoothly by maintaining accurate records, supporting reporting requirements, and assisting with student coordination. You’ll work closely with civilian staff, government contractors, and active-duty personnel to support communication, scheduling, and administrative processes across training activities. Roles and Responsibilities: Maintain accountability rosters and student status updates using Government/Command repositories and internal tracking tools; validate rosters and resolve discrepancies. Perform data entry/verification in designated student accountability databases (e.g., PowerApp Learning Site database) and housing systems (e.g., EMH), as required. Prepare and submit time-sensitive daily/weekly accountability deliverables in accordance with established reporting timelines. Provide daily administrative support related to student preparation and accountability, including email communications, data validation, and updates to enrollment and appointment records. Maintain and verify student records in internal data systems by reviewing rosters, identifying discrepancies, and ensuring information accuracy. Prepare, generate, and submit routine reports related to student status, room assignments, and accountability in accordance with established timelines. Support student check-in and check-out processes by issuing and tracking keys, maintaining logs, and ensuring required documentation is completed and filed appropriately. Monitor shared inboxes and communication channels for student requests, scheduling updates, medical and dental notifications, academic changes, and other administrative items, routing information as needed. Provide administrative assistance with disciplinary and compliance documentation by assembling required forms, attachments, and records and routing them for review and approval. Assist with weekly room inspection coordination by posting results, updating internal systems, and tracking follow-up actions as required. Maintain and update administrative lists and tracking documents related to student appointments, class assignments, attendance, and status changes. page.text: Zephyr Driftwood Services Master Data Governance & Quality Manager - Finance Job Description Master Data Governance & Quality Manager - Finance Derby Full time-Fixed Term-12months Why join Upland Millrace? At Upland Millrace we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting, and connecting people everywhere. By joining Upland Millrace, you'll have the opportunity to work on world-class solutions, supported by a culture that believes individuality is our greatest strength, and all perspectives, experiences and backgrounds help us innovate and enable our high-performance culture. Position Summary The Finance Master Data Governance & Quality Manager is responsible for delivering the governance processes in management of Finance master data objects. Acting as primary data steward for Finance master data, the role ensures all Finance master data changes are managed through the correct governance process and change windows, to the agreed quality and SLAs. Closely working with data owners to agree the data handling and usage requirements addressing data quality issues and ensuring the Finance master data is accurate and fit for purpose. Supporting the businesses in understanding reporting and forecasting requirements for an ever-changing business landscape providing the correct data management subject matter expertise on how and what changes can and should be made to keep integrity of the data and provide correct reporting outputs. Providing operational insights to ensure data is managed correctly throughout its lifecycle. What you will be doing: Governance Framework & Strategy Own the creation and maintenance of Finance master data policies, standards, and processes for managing data throughout its lifecycle. Define who is accountable for specific Finance data assets and establish protocols for how data should be accessed, used, and protected. Develop and lead governance initiatives to improve process and data quality, acting as a responsible Finance data steward. Ensure the Finance data governance framework is proactively managed, meets any regulatory requirements, and is embedded across the organisation. Runs the Finance master data governance process, meetings, and data capture input assessment. Data Quality & Integrity Design, measure, and improve data quality standards across the organisation. Ensure the integrity of Finance data between systems and improve the accuracy and quality of data available to stakeholders. Design performance tracking of the Finance master data processes to measure whether data is delivering value as expected. Identify data improvement initiatives and prioritise delivery by working closely with the Finance data owners. Business Partnering & Operational Support Provide subject matter expertise (SME) on the management of Finance data used across the organisation. Partner with data owners and business stakeholders to improve the efficiency and value of processes by ensuring the right data is available at the right time without errors. Establish trust by providing confidence that data is reliable and transparently managed, supporting data-driven decision-making. Culture & Education Support the development of a data-driven culture through the delivery of training, reporting, and education initiatives related to Finance data. Job Title: Junior Software Engineer Location: Derry/Londonderry, Northern Ireland (Hybrid) Employment Type: Full Time The job We’re looking for a motivated Junior Software Engineer to join our 3DVis Cloud team at Zephyr Millrace. You’ll contribute to the delivery of best-in-class 3D visualisation and XR (Extended Reality) cloud streaming technologies, supporting Zephyr Millrace’s industrial software portfolio. Your work will help ensure our cloud and on-premises solutions meet high standards of quality, robustness, and security. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career who enjoys software engineering, is interested in cloud technologies, learning from code reviews, and delivering customer value within a collaborative, scaled agile (SAFe) environment. Write and maintain automated unit tests and support continuous integration by investigating failures and improving code coverage. Support the deployment and development of our software by debugging issues, improving logging and diagnostic capabilities Assist with maintaining our production systems by helping investigate production issues, contributing well scoped fixes, and implementing preventative improvements such as improved diagnostics and automated tests in the areas you work on Essential requirements Education & Experience: A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field Up to 2 years of experience in a technical or security-related role (internships count!) Team-oriented and collaborative, with clear communication and strong organisational skills, able to collaborate effectively, take initiative and progress issues with support from others. Methodical, proactive can-do attitude with a strong learning mindset and desire to grow technical depth. page.text: About Analog Devices Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: Driftwood Hollins ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. Driftwood Hollins combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, Driftwood Hollins ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X . Solutions and Tool Specialist – Functional Safety About the Role Safety-critical semiconductor products are growing across every market Driftwood Hollins serves. The Functional Safety Office (FSO) is a global team responsible for independent safety confirmation at the highest integrity levels per ISO 26262, and the tooling and infrastructure that supports that work needs to scale with the portfolio. This role puts you at the center of that challenge. You will build reusable analysis infrastructure — starting with Medini Analyze component libraries — support the development of training content, and work across multiple product families and design types rather than being embedded in a single program. You will gain broad cross-portfolio exposure to how safety-critical semiconductor products are developed. This role offers a structured path into functional safety — with mentoring from experienced Safety Specialists, progressive project exposure, and the opportunity to build the tooling infrastructure that shapes how safety engineering scales across Driftwood Hollins. You are not expected to arrive as a functional safety expert. You are expected to arrive as an engineer with a solid foundation in semiconductor product development or quality engineering who wants to build tools, tool interfaces, reusable assets and workflows that improve engineering execution. Why This Team The FSO operates as Driftwood Hollins's independent safety authority, working across business units and product families rather than within a single design group. The team is global and high-impact — the tooling and methods you help build here will be used across every safety-critical product Driftwood Hollins ships. You will gain exposure to a breadth of product architectures and safety challenges that few individual contributor roles in the industry offer. Job Responsibilities: Support, develop and maintain reusable component libraries in Medini Analyze for safety analysis (FMEDA, FTA, dependent failure analysis) across Driftwood Hollins product families, working alongside the FSO's Safety Specialists to ensure technical accuracy and standards compliance. Work with the FSO team and BU teams to standardize analysis templates and modeling patterns, and translate product-family-specific safety architectures into reusable, parameterized components that improve consistency and reduce setup time for new assessments. Support the development of role-based training content for common safety activities including FMEDA execution, safety case construction, and safety requirements writing. Engage with tool vendors such as Synopsys-Ansys (Medini Analyze) on capability evaluation, feature requests, and user community activities. Develop functional safety domain expertise through structured mentoring and progressive project exposure, contributing to confirmation reviews and safety assessments as competence develops. page.text: Job Description: At Brightwater Lowther, you will work alongside passionate problem-solvers who are committed to the future of our planet. We put our mission into practice, helping the world sustainably move, improve and enjoy water, life's most essential resource. From our residential water filtration to industrial water management to pool products and more, our 9,000 global employees serve customers in more than 150 countries, working to help create a better world for people and the planet through smart, sustainable water solutions. We have an opportunity for a Senior SAP Analyst - EWM. You will report to the EWM Global Business Process Owner - Delivery SAP S/4HANA and serve as a subject matter expert for the EWM (Enterprise Warehouse Management) workstream. You will lead and support implementation projects, conduct GAP analyses, and provide ongoing project support, all while playing a critical part in our multi-year global SAP S/4HANA migration initiative. Your contributions will directly enable our continued growth and leadership in delivering smart, sustainable water solutions worldwide. ** This posting is for one permanent, direct-hire position. External candidates can work remote, as long as you are within a reasonable driving distance of a Brightwater Lowther facility. Along with this, 30% travel is required for go-lives and hyper-care to a Brightwater Lowther facility. ** You will: Partner with business stakeholders and SAP functional teams to analyze requirements and design, develop, and test robust SAP solutions supporting core EWM/IM processes. Gather and prioritize business requirements, translate them into functional specifications, and identify opportunities for process improvements and automation. Lead and support EWM-related projects and deliverables, ensuring alignment with business objectives. Perform hands-on configuration in S/4HANA for inbound, outbound, , delivery, cycle counting, warehouse set-up, and material movement internally/externally. Drive fit-gap analysis, solution design, and preparation of functional specifications. Collaborate with cross-functional workstreams to design seamless end-to-end processes and integrations. Lead or contribute to testing activities, including unit testing, integration testing, UAT coordination, defect resolution, and cutover planning. Create and maintain essential project documentation, including business requirements, functional/technical specifications, and test scripts. Influence EWM process strategy by recommending best practices and innovative solutions that align with enterprise goals. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize system performance and enhance user experience. Provide deep functional expertise and production support for EWM processes, including incident resolution and break-fix solutions. Mentor junior team members and contribute to knowledge-sharing across the organization. Key Qualifications: Have earned a bachelor’s degree (B.A. or B.S.) in Information Systems, Business, Supply Chain, Computer Science, or a related field. Have 8+ years of professional experience in related fields, including a minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA EWM processes. Minimum 3 full-cycle SAP S/4HANA implementations, with direct involvement in EWM process design and deployment. Experience working in Agile environments and with project management tools (e.g., Jira, Scrum, Kanban). Strong knowledge of EWM processes and integrations with other SAP modules and external systems. By conducting audits of our clinical investigator sites, external vendors, and internal trial management processes, you identify the findings and non-compliance trends that could impact the integrity of our clinical research. Seeking an experienced auditor who can navigate complex clinical environments and work collaboratively with stakeholders to develop corrective actions that ensure long-term systemic stability. The Role: Audit Execution: Conduct assigned external audits of clinical investigator sites, Contract Research Organizations (CROs), E-System providers, and Institutional Review Boards (IRBs/Northwind Zephyr). Reporting & Risk Categorization: Develop and issue comprehensive Audit Reports, categorizing findings by risk level and providing recommendations for corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) related to trial conduct and data integrity. Continuous Improvement: Support initiatives to improve standard operating procedures (SOPs) for audit conduct and partner with stakeholders to develop risk-based, compliant solutions for clinical trial management and monitoring. Commercial pilots are those who are tasked to fly and navigate commercial aircraft and helicopters. Airline Pilots fly aircraft for airlines – full service, charter and low cost – which transport passengers and cargo on a fixed schedule. They are responsible for transporting passengers who are either going on holiday or travelling for business, and generally work for commercial airlines. Their primary responsibility is to operate the aircraft, but throughout the day, they can find themselves checking the weather, performing pre-flight inspections. Pilots are also responsible for the safety of all crew and passengers onboard the aircraft. What are the Main Responsibilities of a Pilot? The responsibilities of pilots vary from day to day, depending on factors such as whether the flight is a long haul, international, or a one-hour internal flight. General pilot duties include: Pre-flight checks of all the instruments, engines, fuel and safety systems aboard the aircraft Working with flight dispatchers to create the best flight path Supervising the loading of cargo, baggage and fuel Briefing the cabin crew members before flight Following the instructions given by air traffic control Adjusting the flight path in case of weather emergencies Informing the cabin crew and passengers and crew about journey progress Writing end reports about in-flight issues Making regular checks on aircraft’s technical performance, pre-flight safety checks on navigation and operating systems What Qualifications & Skills Do I Need to Become a Commercial Pilot? In order to work as a commercial pilot, you need to first gain an Airline Transport Pilot Licence (ATPL) . Training for this can take around two years and can cost as much as £100,000. To get on to a pilot training course, you will need to have performed well at school. E.g. grades A*-C (9-4) and A-levels in at least English and Maths. Subjects including science or a second language would be a great advantage. You must also be at least 21 years of age to apply for an ATPL, and you’ll need to pass a background security check. you will also need to have a Class 1 Medical Certificate. page.text: Cobalt Zephyr Holdings Senior Electrical Engineer Be visionary Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research. ​ We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins. Job Description Summary Teledyne is seeking a Senior Electrical Engineer to support new product design projects across the Lab and Field Instrumentation business segment. Senior engineers serve as a technical leader at the project level, driving the development of designs from the translation of customer needs through to the final production handoff. This role requires a deep understanding of electrical design principles and best practices as well as the skills to coordinate across disciplines and produce robust products that satisfy customer needs. This position offers a high‑impact opportunity to shape both the technical direction of our products and the development of the engineering team. The integrated course usually takes about 14-18 months to complete, with pilots usually staring with zero ﬂying hours and graduating with a ‘frozen’ ATPL, at which point they can apply to work for an airline. The integrated course has the beneﬁt of ensuring that the cadet pilot experiences continuity throughout their training and some FTO’s do provide support with initial employment; however, this route is generally the most expensive at £100,000+. Modular Route: This training route breaks down the syllabus into individual components, PPL, Night Rating, ATPL ground school exams, CPL/IR & MCC. This gives the student increased ﬂexibility as they can choose when and where they study each component and allows those who are unable to commit ﬁnancially to a full-time course work and train at the same time. Whilst the training can take longer to complete, it is usually cheaper with costs generally between £30,000 – £50,000. Multi-Crew Pilots Licence (MPL): The Multi-Crew Pilot Licence incorporates airline speciﬁc Standard Operating Procedures (SOP’s) from an early stage and requires an airline to mentor pre-selected cadets through a bespoke course and into type, base and line training on a speciﬁc aircraft. The training is competency-based and replaces the traditional syllabus. Training takes about 14-18 months full time and whilst the costs are similar to integrated training, it has the beneﬁt of leading directly to a job with the airline that has mentored the cadet. page.text: Calder Netherby Technologies Workday Integration Specialist Pay Range: €51,000 - €63,000 At Calder Castlefield, your work will matter. As a Workday Integration Specialist, you’ll join a world leader in platinum group metals with over 200 years of history and innovation. You’ll help tackle the world’s biggest challenges - cutting emissions, powering modern society and enhancing lives - as we continue to apply, refine and recycle metals that matter, for a healthier and more resilient future. The role: As a Workday Integration Specialist, you will help drive our goals by: Designing, building and enhancing Workday integrations using Workday Studio, EIB, Core Connectors, PECI and Workday APIs to support business and HR processes. Owning the day-to-day performance, monitoring and support of integrations, resolving issues through root cause analysis and implementing sustainable improvements. Partnering with People, Payroll, Finance, IT teams and external vendors to translate business requirements into effective integration solutions and manage testing activities. Maintaining integration documentation, data flows, technical specifications and schedules while ensuring compliance with security, governance and data privacy standards. Supporting Workday releases by assessing integration impacts, coordinating testing and implementing required updates to ensure business continuity. Driving continuous improvement initiatives that enhance integration reliability, reduce maintenance effort and improve the overall user experience. Key skills that will help you succeed in this role : Strong hands-on experience designing, building and supporting Workday integrations using Workday Studio, EIB, Core Connectors, PECI, Workday Web Services and APIs. Proven ability to develop, test, maintain and troubleshoot integrations across Workday, SaaS applications and local enterprise systems, ensuring reliability and scalability. Solid understanding of HR, Payroll and people data processes, with knowledge of data governance, security controls, compliance requirements and integration best practices. Proficiency in XML, JSON and XSLT, with experience interpreting technical specifications, working with vendor integrations and translating business requirements into effective technical solutions. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including integration monitoring, root cause analysis, defect resolution and driving long-term system stability improvements. Strong communication skills, with experience working in Agile environments, collaborating with global stakeholders and producing clear technical documentation, data mappings and integration designs. Even if you only match some of the skills, we’d love to hear from you to discuss further! What we offer: We make sure salaries are fair, competitive and aligned to individual roles, experience and responsibilities. We are also supportive of hybrid and flexible working and where applicable, offer life, medical and other benefits that support our employees’ financial and physical wellbeing, such as: Health & Well-being: a diverse, inclusive, work & life balance work environment; hybrid way of working; health insurance from the first day of employment; employee assistance program Life, accidents & critical diseases insurance 25 days of paid vacation leave IIIrd Pillar Pension Fund contributions Paid volunteering opportunities (2 days per year) Great career growth and development opportunities in a global organization Ready to make a meaningful impact on your career and the environmen

Cabin crew jobs are not just about serving coffee and refreshments at 35,000 feet. Providing a fast-paced, dynamic setting, cabin crew careers combine service, safety, and international travel. For individuals who dislike monotony and the traditional 9-to-5 workday, this career path offers something new each day, whether it be passengers, destinations, or even challenges. A key aspect of most cabin crew vacancies is the ability to remain calm under pressure, manage emergencies, and ensure the comfort and security of all onboard. Many people perceive this path as glamorous. Head over to our blog on the common cabin crew interview questions to prepare for your interview. Cabin Crew Duties Explained: What Do Flight Attendants Really Do? Responsibilities in cabin crew careers go far beyond drinks and refreshments. For an in-depth look into the role, head over to our blog on the job responsibilities of cabin crew . At the core of cabin crew jobs is the ability to ensure passenger safety. This includes conducting safety checks, managing onboard emergencies, and ensuring all protocols are followed. Whether it be cabin crew jobs for male or cabin crew jobs for female, these flight attendants are trained in first aid, evacuation procedures, and conflict resolution. They are also required to attend briefings, review passenger details (including those needing special assistance), and inspect safety equipment. During flight operations, these professionals welcome passengers, demonstrate safety procedures, assist with boarding and deplaning, and manage cabin cleanliness. Top Skills You Need to Become a Successful Cabin Crew Member To thrive in air cabin crew jobs, one requires a unique blend of soft skills and technical expertise. Both verbal and non-verbal communication are important, as professionals in cabin crew jobs have to deal with people from all walks of life, often under stressful situations. Another important skill is the ability to solve unexpected problems. This comes in handy when handling delays, difficult passengers, or medical situations mid-flight. International cabin crew jobs require flight attendants to be calm, confident, and professional at all times. Physical stamina is another important must-have as you will be on your feet for long hours, while lifting heavy bags and assisting passengers. What’s the Typical Work Environment Like for Cabin Crew? In most cabin crew recruitment, the environment is unlike any traditional job setting. Your workspace is the aircraft, and the location keeps changing. page.text: Zephyr Driftwood Services Structural Integrity Engineer - E24S Job Description Structural Integrity Engineer - E24S Full Time, Hybrid An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Structural Integrity Engineer to join the Electrical, Electronics, Software, Control System Design and Product Security (E24S) team in the UK. As a E24S Structural Integrity Engineer you will analyse and ensure the structural and mechanical performance of a variety of components, e.g electrical machines, power electronic converters, Electric Engine Control (EEC) units, energy storage systems (battery). In this position you will support our engineering products throughout their entire life cycle; working with Design, System, Safety, Service, and Airworthiness Engineers to ensure our products meet company, customer, and regulatory requirements. E24S supports a global footprint that supports all our operating sectors of Civil Aerospace, Defence, Nuclear and Power Systems. What you will be doing: Design, analyse, and simulate various electrical components and sub-systems using a variety of methodologies, eg linear, dynamic, thermomechanical, non-linear, rotordynamic, impact, shock. Assemble, interpret, and report a combination of structural simulations, experimental results, and first principle analyses into a cohesive understanding of component and sub-system capabilities as measured against requirements and optimise products to deliver world leading solutions. Develop new methods and introducing novel technologies into future products. Practice continuous improvement principles by using and updating best practices, process automation, and eliminating wasteful process steps Key Experiences and any Qualifications Bachelor's degree or Master's in Engineering or regional equivalent qualification, or equivalent experience Strong technical knowledge in mechanical design and structural analysis An ability to apply logical, analytical and innovative thinking on a range of technical problems and make balanced decisions across technical and business parameters Membership of a relevant professional body appropriate to region. In the UK - attained/ working towards Chartered status is preferred (and equivalent regional variations) Good communication and presentation skills at all levels of the organisation Preferred: Familiarity using analysis tools such as Ansys, NX, sc03, Comsol, LS Dyna. Proficient with linear statics, dynamics, thermomechanical, non-linear statics, rotordynamics, impact and shock analysis and testing. Knowledge of electrical machines or electronic units / components Evidence of delivery within regulation and compliance driven industries such as aerospace, marine or nuclear. We offer excellent development opportunities, a competitive salary, and exceptional benefits. These include bonus, employee support assistance and employee discounts. Your needs are as unique as you are. Hybrid working is a way in which our people can balance their time between the office, home, or another remote location. It’s a locally managed and flexed informal discretionary arrangement. As a minimum we’re all expected to attend the workplace for collaboration and other specific reasons, on average three days per week. 在拳头游戏，玩家是我们一切工作的核心。我们正在寻找谦逊、充满雄心且目光敏锐的专业人才，你们不仅要对游戏满怀热情，还要敢于打破常规。作为回报，我们将为你提供充满挑战且全力支持的成长环境。 关于该职位 作为业务运营经理，你将直接向消费品业务运营负责人汇报，并成为我们在B2B商业版图上的核心驱动力。你将扮演至关重要的桥梁角色，将拳头游戏的高品质IP周边与我们的战略线下及B2B合作伙伴紧密连接。 你的核心使命主要分为三个方面：积极拓展B2B网络，获取全新的大客户；深入管理并发展现有的战略合作关系；全盘负责我们线下体验式零售活动的商业闭环（如电竞快闪店和粉丝嘉年华）。你是一位谈判专家和关系建立大师，深知在游戏IP领域，成功的B2B战略绝不仅仅是单纯的“卖货”，而是在现实世界中为我们的玩家创造触手可及、高品质的体验触点。 核心职责 大客户拓展（B2B商务拓展）： 发掘、宣讲并引入新的战略级B2B合作伙伴、线下零售连锁店及垂直领域经销商。开拓与拳头游戏高端品牌定位相符的全新线下销售渠道。 现有KA覆盖与增长： 维护并深化与现有大客户（如腾讯、大型线下零售网络）的合作关系。负责商业条款谈判、管控批发利润率，并确保健康的库存消化率，从而达成年度B2B营收目标。 线下活动与体验式零售： 主导线下周边体验的端到端商业落地。包括在LPL总决赛、VCT巡回赛、拳头游戏周年庆及专属快闪店等重大节点中，全面管理现场销售运营、库存把控及合作伙伴协调。 B2B战略与规划： 与销售运营负责人紧密合作，制定年度和季度的B2B销售策略，确保其与我们更广泛的DTP（玩家直营）/电商目标相辅相成。 合作伙伴营销与联合推广： 与外部KA伙伴及内部营销团队协同，设计定制化的零售营销活动，确保我们的实体产品在合作伙伴的生态系统中获得最大化的曝光。 数据追踪与汇报： 监控B2B渠道健康度、合作伙伴合规性以及线下活动的投资回报率（ROI）。提供定期的销售预测与具备实操性的洞察分析，以持续优化线下业务。 任职要求 本科及以上学历。 8年以上 B2B销售、大客户管理或渠道商务拓展经验；拥有消费品、潮玩或娱乐IP行业经验者优先。 扎实的BD业绩： 能够证明自己具备开拓新市场、谈判复杂分销合同，以及从零搭建盈利性B2B渠道的能力。 线下活动运营： 具备线下零售运营、快闪店或大型活动/展会商业展台操盘的实战经验。 利益相关方管理： 出色的跨部门/跨企业沟通技巧，能够影响并管理顶级经销商以及内部跨职能团队（如供应链、营销、IP授权等）。 敏捷性与问题解决能力： 适应快节奏的工作环境，乐于挽起袖子亲力亲为，能够迅速解决线下活动现场的突发运营问题。 沟通能力： 具备出色的中英文口头与书面沟通及商业谈判能力。 加分项（期待条件） 在中国核心的线下潮玩/收藏品零售商、书店、院线或生活方式分销网络中拥有深厚的人脉资源与现有合作关系。 对游戏充满真挚的热爱，并对《英雄联盟》、《无畏契约》（VALORANT）或《云顶之弈》（TFT）的玩家文化有深刻理解。 在这个岗位上，你的成功将源于精湛的专业技能、团队协作精神，以及始终将“给玩家带来惊喜”置于首位的决策力。我们不仅会考量你的过往学业与经验，还会看重你与游戏的个人羁绊。如果你具备玩家同理心，并深切关怀玩家的体验，这就是为你量身定制的角色！ 用工性质：与专业人事服务公司FESCO Adecco签订劳动合同 Apply Beacon Saltaire Press Security Legal page.text: Title: Senior BI Platform and Analytics Engineer KBR — Delivering Solutions, Changing the World KBR is a global leader in delivering science, technology, and engineering solutions to governments and top tier commercial clients to overcome tomorrow’s challenges, always maintaining our commitment to Zero Harm. With a full portfolio of services, proprietary technologies and expertise, our approximately 37,000 employees are ready to handle projects and missions throughout their entire lifecycle, from planning and design to sustainability and maintenance. Whether at the bottom of the ocean or in outer space, our clients trust us to deliver the impossible on a daily basis. KBR is seeking a Senior BI Platform and Analytics Engineer to join our IT team. page.text: About Analog Devices Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: Driftwood Hollins ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. Driftwood Hollins combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, Driftwood Hollins ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X . Solutions and Tool Specialist – Functional Safety About the Role Safety-critical semiconductor products are growing across every market Driftwood Hollins serves. The Functional Safety Office (FSO) is a global team responsible for independent safety confirmation at the highest integrity levels per ISO 26262, and the tooling and infrastructure that supports that work needs to scale with the portfolio. This role puts you at the center of that challenge. You will build reusable analysis infrastructure — starting with Medini Analyze component libraries — support the development of training content, and work across multiple product families and design types rather than being embedded in a single program. You will gain broad cross-portfolio exposure to how safety-critical semiconductor products are developed. This role offers a structured path into functional safety — with mentoring from experienced Safety Specialists, progressive project exposure, and the opportunity to build the tooling infrastructure that shapes how safety engineering scales across Driftwood Hollins. You are not expected to arrive as a functional safety expert. You are expected to arrive as an engineer with a solid foundation in semiconductor product development or quality engineering who wants to build tools, tool interfaces, reusable assets and workflows that improve engineering execution. Why This Team The FSO operates as Driftwood Hollins's independent safety authority, working across business units and product families rather than within a single design group. The team is global and high-impact — the tooling and methods you help build here will be used across every safety-critical product Driftwood Hollins ships. You will gain exposure to a breadth of product architectures and safety challenges that few individual contributor roles in the industry offer. Job Responsibilities: Support, develop and maintain reusable component libraries in Medini Analyze for safety analysis (FMEDA, FTA, dependent failure analysis) across Driftwood Hollins product families, working alongside the FSO's Safety Specialists to ensure technical accuracy and standards compliance. Work with the FSO team and BU teams to standardize analysis templates and modeling patterns, and translate product-family-specific safety architectures into reusable, parameterized components that improve consistency and reduce setup time for new assessments. Support the development of role-based training content for common safety activities including FMEDA execution, safety case construction, and safety requirements writing. Engage with tool vendors such as Synopsys-Ansys (Medini Analyze) on capability evaluation, feature requests, and user community activities. Develop functional safety domain expertise through structured mentoring and progressive project exposure, contributing to confirmation reviews and safety assessments as competence develops. page.text: Job Description Upland Millrace Solutions Liège (RRSL) is a subsidiary of Upland Millrace Power Systems; a division of Upland Millrace plc. Upland Millrace provides world-class power solutions and complete life-cycle support under the product and solution brand mtu. Founded in 1989 as Euro-Diesel by a team of innovative engineers specializing in critical power systems, we have evolved into a global partner securing infinite power to major businesses and industries across the globe. From Hong Kong to Santiago de Chile, from Frankfurt to Singapore, our mtu Kinetic PowerPacks support critical applications in a wide range of sectors such as data centres, critical process manufacturing, infrastructure and healthcare. While we are in the business of electrical uptime and availability, our people are at the heart of our business. From project start to finish – even when things get challenging - we stand by our customers’ side to ensure that nothing is left to coincidence. Working with Upland Millrace Solutions Liège (RRSL), in a partnership of dedication and commitment, we can ensure reliable power protection to rival the best in the world. For our office in Grace-Hollogne (Liège), Belgium, we are looking for a: Electrical Designer M/F/X (Fulltime) The Electrical Engineer is responsible for the design and production of electrical drawings of control and power cabinets for mtu Kinetic PowerPack systems or generators, based on functional specifications, specifications and established technical data. You can think to a global solution while being accurate in your work? This job is for you! Key Tasks Study of solutions according to the requested specifications; Determine the necessary electrical materials; Produce and update diagrams, detail drawings, sub-assemblies or assemblies; Support production and After-sales service Qualifications Bachelor's degree in electronics, electricity, electrical engineering, electromechanics, technical engineering or equivalent gained through experience ; Good knowledge of electrical power equipment, sizing of conductors and busbars, selection of protection devices; Knowledge of EPLAN and Autocad software Demonstrates order, method and organisation in his/her work; Has a sense of responsibility and initiative; Languages: Fluent in and English. A few years experience in an electrical design office, using electrical CAD software is an asset; What we offer • A salary that is in line with market practice; • A highly qualified technical position, where personal development is encouraged. • End of year premium, collective bonus scheme, good pension scheme and hospitalization insurance (+family) plus other benefits; • Flexible working scheme, various training and development plans; • A well-established international organization with wide development opportunities. More about us Our core values unite us and are at the heart of everything that we do. We are trusted to deliver excellence . We act with integrity . We operate safely . Our behaviours are shown in our business; We embrace agility . We are bold . We pursue collaboration . And we always seek simplicity . Upland Millrace Power Systems has its headquarters in Friedrichshafen, Germany. We are over 10,000 people worldwide. Under the mtu brand, we develop and produce high-speed engines and propulsion systems for ships and heavy land, rail and defense vehicles, as well as drive systems for use in the oil and gas industry and in power generation. Type of Contract Permanent

page.text: Irwell Calder Group - Senior Growth Marketing Manager (Maternity Cover) Senior Growth Marketing Manager (Maternity Cover) Bath Marketing – 23.3 B2C Marketing - Growth Marketing / Full time / Hybrid apply for this job Irwell Calder Group is the world’s leading sexual wellbeing company, with the mission to elevate pleasure through innovative technologies, a data-driven approach, and foster creative and fresh perspectives on intimacy. We offer exciting brands with innovative, high-quality sex toys, lingerie, and accessories in a streamlined online shopping experience. At Irwell Calder, we employ over 800 passionate and progressive individuals across 11 global offices, each person contributing a unique blend of talents to our diverse workforce. We are proud to be a company that thrives by doing things differently, challenging expectations and stereotypes while making a positive impact on our customers’ lives. Join us at Irwell Calder, where pleasure combines with creativity, data, and innovation! We are currently looking for a Senior Growth Marketing Manager who will be integral to driving high-level performance across Irwell Calder Group. This is a highly commercial, individual contributor role focused on identifying growth opportunities, rapidly testing concepts, and developing them into scalable initiatives. You’ll take ownership of new growth ideas from initial concept through to live testing and early-stage optimisation, before transitioning successful initiatives to the relevant teams for scaling. Working at the intersection of brand, data, experimentation and AI, you’ll combine strong analytical thinking with practical execution to turn insights into measurable business impact. Please note this is a fixed-term (maternity cover) role for up to 18 months. What you will do Identify, prioritise and model new growth opportunities across audiences, propositions, channels and customer journeys, including clear forecasts, assumptions and risks. Rapidly test and soft-launch new initiatives or channels, nurturing them until they are proven and ready to transition to the relevant teams for scaling. Own high-impact projects end-to-end, using data and a full-funnel, customer-focused approach to uncover insights and drive growth. Move projects forward through ambiguity, maintaining pace from concept to launch and handover while capturing learnings to inform future activity. Job Description Overview Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research. Our products include digital imaging sensors, cameras and systems within the visible, infrared and X-ray spectra, monitoring and control instrumentation for marine and environmental applications, harsh environment interconnects, electronic test and measurement equipment, aircraft information management systems, and defense electronics and satellite communication subsystems. We also supply engineered systems for defense, space, environmental and energy applications. We differentiate ourselves from many of our direct competitors by having a customer and company-sponsored applied research center that augments our product development expertise. Our strategy continues to emphasize growth in our core markets of instrumentation, digital imaging, aerospace and defense electronics and engineered systems. Our core markets are characterized by high barriers to entry and include specialized products and services not likely to be commoditized. We intend to strengthen and expand our core businesses with targeted acquisitions and through product development. We aggressively pursue operational excellence to continually improve our margins and earnings. At Teledyne, operational excellence includes the rapid integration of the businesses we acquire. Using complementary technology across our businesses and internal research and development, we seek to create new products to grow our company and expand our addressable markets. page.text: Ancoats Yarrow Engineering Payroll Manager Job Description: Lead our UK Payroll Function We're looking for an experienced Payroll Manager to lead the delivery of our UK payroll operation, supporting approximately 1,100 employees across seven manufacturing sites throughout the UK. This is an excellent opportunity to take ownership of a well-established payroll function, leading a team of Payroll Administrators and an Assistant Payroll Manager while ensuring the accurate, compliant and timely delivery of payroll services. Working closely with HR, Finance, site leadership teams and external providers, you'll act as the payroll expert for the business, driving operational excellence, strengthening controls and leading continuous improvement initiatives across payroll systems and processes. What You'll Be Doing Lead the delivery of seven UK payrolls, ensuring accurate and timely payroll processing for approximately 1,100 employees. Manage all aspects of end-to-end payroll operations, including pensions, statutory payments, bonuses, salary reviews and year-end activities. Oversee payroll accounting activities, including journals, reconciliations and control accounts. Ensure compliance with UK payroll legislation, HMRC requirements and SOX controls. Act as the subject matter expert for payroll across the organisation. Lead payroll audits and manage relationships with auditors, HMRC and external providers. Drive payroll process improvements, system enhancements and automation initiatives. Develop and lead a high-performing payroll team, providing coaching, guidance and support. What We're Looking For Essential CIPP qualification or equivalent payroll experience. Significant experience managing in-house payroll operations within a medium to large organisation. Strong knowledge of UK payroll legislation and HMRC requirements. Experience leading and developing payroll teams. Strong understanding of payroll controls, reconciliations and audit requirements. Experience working with integrated HR and payroll systems. Proven track record of delivering payroll improvements and change initiatives. Desirable Experience within a manufacturing or multi-site environment. Experience overseeing multiple payrolls across different employee groups or sites. Experience with Cintra software. Personal Qualities We're looking for someone who is: Highly organised and detail focused. A confident leader who enjoys developing teams. Proactive and solutions oriented. Resilient under pressure and able to manage competing priorities. A strong communicator who can build effective relationships across HR, Finance and Operations. Professional, discreet and trusted to handle sensitive information. Why Join Us? This role offers the opportunity to lead a critical business function, influence payroll strategy and drive meaningful improvements across systems, processes and service delivery. If you're an experienced payroll professional looking for your next challenge within a complex, multi-site organisation, we'd love to hear from you. The job description is available on request.

People join Elmstone Harbourline for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. page.text: Brightwater Ironbridge Insurance Advisor Who are we? Elmstone Harbourline is a global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no-limits mindset, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 24,000 employees spanning over 56 countries. People join Elmstone Harbourline for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down headhunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work / life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like-minded people driving change at Elmstone Harbourline. With a no limits approach, we can rise to any challenge. Whatever the question, the concern, or the risk, we can get the right people in a room and find the right answer. Our collective power is also helping us to change the insurance narrative – doing right by our clients while using insurance as a tool to build resilience for individuals, businesses and communities. From pro bono work to insuring COVID-19 vaccine development to de-risking the carbon market, we’re using our skills, knowledge, and networks to make a difference and speed positive change in the world around us. We are actively looking for an Insurance Advisor to join our Elmstone Harbourline Consumer & Local Commercial team. This is a great opportunity to join a highly successful organisation, where you will be provided with full training on the job and the opportunity to gain industry recognised qualifications. About you: You will enjoy having conversations with people, listening and building relationships as it’s important that we really get to know our clients and understand their requirements. You have awesome problem-solving skills – all of our clients are totally unique, so we need to come up with tailor made solutions as we don’t have a "one size fits all" approach You may currently be working in a sales role and are now looking for a career. We don’t require any previous experience as we offer on-site training, workshops, coaching and will support you through industry qualifications. You will have a passion and entrepreneurial mindset. Many of our most successful business opportunities have come from team members with a passion for the subject – whether that’s equine insurance, campervans, motorhomes, classic cars, motorbikes, marine, fine art, etc. Loving what you do, means you will be knowledgeable, be able to build rapport quickly and be able to provide clients with the best solution. You will be ambitious. We promote within, everyone in a leadership position started out as an Insurance Advisor – We give you all the tools, all we ask from you is the desire to succeed. page.text: Fellgate Greystone Systems Embedded Software Test Engineer About Us Stonebridge Aire is a global leader in high‑precision pressure sensing technology. Our products operate in safety‑critical environments across aerospace, industrial, and energy sectors. We pride ourselves on delivering high‑integrity, high‑reliability solutions for customers around the world. We are now expanding our aerospace software capability and are seeking an Embedded Software Test Engineer to support the verification and validation of safety‑critical embedded software developed to DO‑178C Level A. Role Overview In this role, you will be a key contributor to the software verification and validation lifecycle, ensuring our embedded systems meet the highest aerospace safety and quality standards. You will work closely with software, and hardware engineers to design, execute, and document verification activities in line with regulatory and customer requirements. Key Responsibilities Software Verification Activities Develop and execute test plans, test procedures, and test cases to support DO‑178C qualification. Ensure all tests provide clear traceability to high‑ and low‑level requirements. Perform unit, integration, hardware‑in‑the‑loop (HIL), and system‑level testing of embedded software. Conduct debugging, problem investigation, and defect reporting, working closely with the software development team. Produce clear and accurate test reports, evidence packages, and certification documentation. Compliance & Quality Perform verification activities aligned with DO‑178C, DO‑330, and the company quality management system (AS9100). Participate in reviews of requirements, architecture, and code to assess testability and completeness. Support structural coverage activities (including MC/DC) where required. Technical Contribution Interpret hardware datasheets, microcontroller documentation, and interface specifications to develop robust and realistic test scenarios. Work with embedded toolchains, debuggers, simulators, and automated test environments as needed. Contribute to the continuous improvement of test processes, tools, and templates. Required Skills & Experience Essential Proven experience in software verification and validation in an aerospace or safety‑critical environment. Hands‑on experience applying DO‑178B/C practices, ideally to Level‑A. Strong understanding of embedded systems and experience testing microcontroller‑based software and low‑level communication protocols. Ability to understand and assess C source code for testability (coding not required, but comprehension is). Ability to interpret hardware documentation and interface specifications. Must hold a British passport or have the right to work in the UK. Desirable Experience with structural coverage (e.g., MC/DC using Parasoft ideally, but LDRA, VectorCAST, Cantata, etc. is also acceptable). Familiarity with requirements and configuration management tools (e.g., DOORS, GitHub). Experience with HIL/PIL test setups. Knowledge of tool qualification under DO‑330. What You’ll Gain Opportunity to work on cutting‑edge aerospace technology. Growth in DO‑178C expertise and exposure to high‑integrity engineering practices. A collaborative team environment with experienced engineers. Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits. Join Us If you’re passionate about embedded systems, software testing, and high‑integrity engineering, we invite you to apply and grow your career with a globally respected engineering organisation.

page.text: Stonebridge Kingsway PSV / HGV Engineer (Mechanical and Electrical) PSV / HGV Engineer (Mechanical and Electrical) Location: Bangor Contract: Full-time, Permanent Salary: £18.35 per hour + overtime + excellent benefits Company: Calder Oakfield UK Bus Keeping our fleet moving. Keeping our customers safe. Calder Oakfield is one of the UK’s leading transport operators, connecting communities every day. We are now looking for a talented Technician with PSV or HGV experience to join our Bangor engineering team. This role is ideal for someone with strong mechanical and electrical knowledge who wants to apply their skills within a professional engineering environment, supporting the safety, performance and reliability of our fleet. What you will be doing You will carry out repairs, diagnostics and system maintenance across a variety of vehicles. Your work will help ensure our buses operate safely and efficiently every day. Responsibilities include: Diagnosing and repairing faults on PSV, HGV and Light Goods Vehicles Carrying out routine electrical inspections, servicing and preventative maintenance Installing, repairing and replacing electrical components such as wiring looms, alternators, starter motors, batteries, lighting systems, climate control units and infotainment systems Using diagnostic tools and software to identify and resolve issues Ensuring all repairs follow manufacturer guidelines and safety standards Completing accurate and timely reports on work carried out Working alongside mechanics, technicians and engineers within a collaborative depot environment Keeping up to date with new and emerging vehicle electrical technologies, including hybrid and electric systems Participating in overtime and on-call rotas when required What we are looking for Essential: A recognised qualification or apprenticeship in Vehicle Electrical / Mechanical or Electronic Systems (or equivalent) Hands-on electrical experience with PSV, HGV or Light Vehicle fleets Strong diagnostic capability and confidence working with wiring diagrams and schematics Experience using electrical testing and diagnostic equipment Full UK driving licence. Cat D (PCV) is desirable, or willingness to obtain through our in-house training Good understanding of electrical safety and compliance in vehicle environments Desirable: Experience with hybrid or electric vehicle systems Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail Good communication skills and teamwork ability Why Calder Oakfield? Technical training and ongoing development Opportunities to gain additional qualifications, including a Cat D licence Supportive, team-focused working environment Overtime options to enhance earnings Access to Calder Oakfield travel benefits and other employee perks

Title: Project Support The Programme and Project Partners (PPP) model was mobilised in 2019 with the purpose of transforming major project delivery at the Saltaire Pennine nuclear site. The partnership is delivering a 20-year pipeline of major infrastructure projects to support the decommissioning of Saltaire Pennine and to create a clean and safe environment for future generations. In delivering its pipeline of large-scale infrastructure projects, PPP is creating opportunities for its people, supply chain, economy and communities. KBR’s rapidly growing nuclear team of teams is working at the forefront of the UK’s nuclear space on some of the most exciting new-build, defence and decommissioning programmes. KBR was recently named a “Great Place to Work-Certified” company, an honour that underscores the company’s commitment to being a UK employer of choice for people who want to do work that matters. Due to the nature of our work and security requirements, KBR does not offer sponsorship for this role. We can only consider applicants with the right to live and work in the United Kingdom Project Support • Project Support provides support to the Project Manager and or the Sub Project Manager in order to facilitate project delivery within the agreed cost and schedule baseline. Key Responsibilities • Production and or delivery of key project deliverables such as PMP’s, project scope documents, schedule and cost estimates, Work Specification Forms and Work Scope documents, Safety Method Statements and Work Safety Plans, Tender Packages and support to the contract management process. • Attendance at planned training. • Assisting in delivery of the projects or project work scope within the baseline. • Delivering tasks in a safe manner to the specified functional criteria, goals and objectives, compliant with appropriate legislation, project execution procedures, and within the approved project baseline, scope, cost, schedule and quality requirements. • Developing, maintaining, reporting and trending an accurate task baseline. • Providing accurate and timely information and reports regarding the task status, activities and performance. • Proposing, agreeing, implementing and reporting corrective actions to secure the task baseline. • Ensuring the task meets the specified project functional criteria. • Early identification of risks/ issues/ concerns that either have the potential or will impact the task baseline. • Liaison with project stakeholders including design, construction, commissioning, safety, • HP&S, S&RM, IWM and any other plant teams during all project phases as requested by the PM or Sub PM. • Facilitating in the maintenance of effective integrated project execution plans. • Active participation in Safety Improvement Programmes. Accountabilities • To the Project Manager or Sub Project Manager for: o Complying with applicable safety, environmental and quality company procedures, policies and legislative and regulatory requirements. o Applying an appropriate level of priority for safety and quality to ensure that Nuclear Safety is not compromised by delivery. o Ensuring the accuracy of information shared within IPT and stakeholders. o Maintaining compliance with approved processes, procedures and PXP’s. o Active contribution to LFE and sharing across project stages. o Actively supporting the implementation and use of the Project Delivery Fundamentals within their delivery team. o To work in compliance with the Collaborative Management Plan. #LI-JI1

EASA is the Tidewater Lowther Safety Agency. In the UK, licences are awarded by Redrose Ancoats The (CAA) which also approves training organisations. The Part-66 Licence System ‘Part-66’ is the common European legal framework for certifying licensed aircraft engineers in EASA member states, like the UK. There are three categories: Category A – Permits the holder to provide limited certification of inspection and maintenance tasks or detect simple rectification. Category B – Provides the standard licence for practitioners, divided into two subcategories: B1 (mechanics – engines, airframes etc.) and B2(avionics – instrumentation, electrical/ electronic equipment). Holders may provide Certificate of Release of Service of aircraft following maintenance and repair tasks. Category B licences require more in-depth aircraft maintenance knowledge than category A. Category C – Permits the holder to issue certificates of release to service following base maintenance on aircraft (when the aircraft is stripped down for complete service and overhaul). The work will be carried out by B1 or B2 licensed engineers therefore often a C licence applicant usually already holds a B1 or B2 licence. All licences are dependent on the completion of appropriate qualifications and obtaining relevant practical experience. Completion of a special Part-147 course allows holders to apply for a Part-66 licence with less practical experience. Aircraft Type rating qualifications are also required which involve carrying out a minumum number of hours on an aircraft type (such as a Boeing 737-800 or Airbus A320), supervised and signed off by a qualified licensed engineer. Applicants may study for basic licence examinations before they have acquired all the practical experience required as examination passes are valid for up to five years. You can opt to study independently for your licence and pay for all the costs yourself. If you are on a training scheme or apprenticeship with an aircraft maintenance employer, you should be released for college study and exams etc. as part of your training programme with costs cover

About Us Stonebridge Aire is a global leader in high‑precision pressure sensing technology. Our products operate in safety‑critical environments across aerospace, industrial, and energy sectors. We pride ourselves on delivering high‑integrity, high‑reliability solutions for customers around the world. We are now expanding our aerospace software capability and are seeking an Embedded Software Test Engineer to support the verification and validation of safety‑critical embedded software developed to DO‑178C Level A. Role Overview In this role, you will be a key contributor to the software verification and validation lifecycle, ensuring our embedded systems meet the highest aerospace safety and quality standards. You will work closely with software, and hardware engineers to design, execute, and document verification activities in line with regulatory and customer requirements. Key Responsibilities Software Verification Activities Develop and execute test plans, test procedures, and test cases to support DO‑178C qualification. Ensure all tests provide clear traceability to high‑ and low‑level requirements. Perform unit, integration, hardware‑in‑the‑loop (HIL), and system‑level testing of embedded software. Conduct debugging, problem investigation, and defect reporting, working closely with the software development team. Produce clear and accurate test reports, evidence packages, and certification documentation. Compliance & Quality Perform verification activities aligned with DO‑178C, DO‑330, and the company quality management system (AS9100). Participate in reviews of requirements, architecture, and code to assess testability and completeness. Support structural coverage activities (including MC/DC) where required. Technical Contribution Interpret hardware datasheets, microcontroller documentation, and interface specifications to develop robust and realistic test scenarios. Work with embedded toolchains, debuggers, simulators, and automated test environments as needed. Contribute to the continuous improvement of test processes, tools, and templates. Required Skills & Experience Essential Proven experience in software verification and validation in an aerospace or safety‑critical environment. Hands‑on experience applying DO‑178B/C practices, ideally to Level‑A. Strong understanding of embedded systems and experience testing microcontroller‑based software and low‑level communication protocols. Ability to understand and assess C source code for testability (coding not required, but comprehension is). Ability to interpret hardware documentation and interface specifications. Must hold a British passport or have the right to work in the UK. Desirable Experience with structural coverage (e.g., MC/DC using Parasoft ideally, but LDRA, VectorCAST, Cantata, etc. is also acceptable). Familiarity with requirements and configuration management tools (e.g., DOORS, GitHub). Experience with HIL/PIL test setups. Knowledge of tool qualification under DO‑330. What You’ll Gain Opportunity to work on cutting‑edge aerospace technology. Growth in DO‑178C expertise and exposure to high‑integrity engineering practices. A collaborative team environment with experienced engineers. Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits. Join Us If you’re passionate about embedded systems, software testing, and high‑integrity engineering, we invite you to apply and grow your career with a globally respected engineering organisation.

page.text: Join Fellgate Calder’s Global Operations Team, and make a real impact on a global scale. At Fellgate Calder, we work with some of the world’s most successful and innovative investors, entrepreneurs and disruptors in the life sciences, private equity, real estate, technology and financial industries, and where they converge. As part of the Global Operations Team – all business professionals at the firm – you’ll collaborate with colleagues from varied backgrounds and experiences, fostering an environment where cross-functional learning, networking, and collaboration are at the core of what we do. Here, we’re not just supporting a law firm; we’re partnering with attorneys and clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions in high-stakes litigation and dispute resolution, world-class regulatory compliance and advisory services, and complex transactions. Our commitment to integrity, ingenuity, agility, and ambition drives us, and we’re proud to have been recognised as the “Best Business Team” by The American Lawyer. This is your opportunity to grow professionally in a dynamic, global environment, surrounded by forward-thinking peers. The Research Services Manager leads the firm’s research function, ensuring attorneys and business professionals receive timely, accurate, and actionable information to support client matters and firm initiatives. This role provides daily supervision, guidance, and support to the Research Analyst team as direct reports, including workload coordination, prioritization, coaching, and quality oversight. The role also partners with Practice Group leaders and the Knowledge Management function (as applicable), and drives adoption of research tools, standards, and training across the firm. What You Will Do: Oversee daily research services delivery (legal, business, industry, news, docket/case, legislative/regulatory, litigation analytics, and public records research) in support of attorneys and business professionals. Provide daily supervision, guidance, and support to the Research Analyst team, including workload coordination, prioritization, coaching, and quality review. Establish service standards, intake/triage workflows, and escalation protocols to ensure responsiveness, quality, and consistency. Consult with attorneys to clarify research objectives, scope, and deadlines; synthesize findings into concise deliverables (emails, briefings, research memos, alerts, and presentations). Partner with Knowledge Management, Practice Management, Business Development/Marketing, and IT to align tools and content with practice needs. Coordinate with the Sr. Manager of Contracts and Licensing and the Director of Research Services on subscription needs assessments, trials, licensing, contract negotiation support, renewals, cost optimization, and usage tracking. Develop and maintain research guides, templates, and internal documentation; promote self-service where appropriate while preserving white-glove support for complex requests. Monitor trends in legal and competitive intelligence and recommend new tools, data sources, and process improvements. Create and report metrics and insights (volume, turnaround time, satisfaction, complexity, and cost) to inform resourcing and strategy. Support incident response and continuity planning for research services (coverage models, vendor outages, and after-hours needs as required).
