page.text: Line of Service Advisory Industry/Sector Not Applicable Specialism Managed Services Management Level Senior Associate Job Description & Summary As a Senior Associate – Cyber Security Forward Deployed you are a multi-faceted technologist. You lean heavily into using AI, are comfortable working in a client’s environment, writing code, integrating disparate security tools, and build production-ready defense systems. You will be both part of and/or leading the planning and execution of a variety of opportunities including AI to Defend and/or cloud and application security initiatives for our clients. You will architect deeply technical solutions, lead cross-functional engineering pods, and convert client ambiguity into shipped capabilities. You will simultaneously drive practice growth —while remaining hands-on and technical. You will be a key technical contributor in PwC’s Cybersecurity Consulting practice. You’ll work closely with managers and other team members to design and implement security solutions (e.g. Cloud/App Security, AI to Defend) for our clients, helping secure their cloud environments and software development processes. In this consulting role, you will tackle complex security challenges – performing analyses, setting up security controls, conducting assessments – and collaborate with cross-functional teams (cloud engineers, developers, risk advisors) to embed security throughout clients’ digital transformation projects. You’ll also engage with client stakeholders, own technical workstreams end-to-end and ensure security recommendations align with business goals and are clearly communicated. This position offers an opportunity to build your expertise in cloud infrastructure security, secure application development, DevSecOps and emerging capabilities/skills in AI, while growing your consulting skills in a dynamic, client-facing environment. You operate as the senior engineer on a delivery pod, mentor Associates, own technical workstreams end-to-end, and translate client ambiguity into shipped, production-ready solutions. The Opportunity: As a Senior Associate – Cyber Security Forward Deployed Engineer , unlock your potential and embrace the chance to drive meaningful outcomes that’ll elevate your career. Your role will include, but isn’t limited to: Design, develop, test, and deploy security solutions across cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP) and applications (SDLC integrations, AppSec pipelines) Implement and integrate a variety of security products ( e.g. Cloud & Application Security) ; configure secure baselines; perform cloud and Kubernetes security architecture reviews and remediation. Build production-quality code and infrastructure including but not limited to secure CI/CD pipelines, IaC modules, cloud landing zones. Work with cloud architects and developers to implement security solutions including cloud platforms and applications . Configure security controls (identity & access management, data encryption, network security) and ensure cloud configurations follow leading security practices and compliance requirements. Conduct security assessments and threat modeling for client cloud environments and applications, identifying vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and compliance gaps. Deliver cloud and application security strategy engagements and advise organization s on how to transform their current cloud & application security practice. Integrate security into the software development lifecycle , collaborating with DevOps teams

Our modern facilities in Caerphilly operate with minimal impact on the environment, driven by ambitious targets to drive forward green manufacturing practices. Our exceptional teams apply their first-class technical, customer service and manufacturing expertise to understand our customers’ needs and solve today’s ventilation challenges. Our loyal and highly skilled workforce are key to our success of delivering clean air, everywhere. Now part of the Greystone Mersey Group, Delta North Quayside has ambitious growth plans. Ensure communication and close working relationships are developed with the internal commercial sales office, technical teams and wider company areas. Report market conditions and competitor activity into the business. Support marketing initiatives to actively promote Delta North Quayside product ranges internally and externally in order to maintain high levels of brand and product awareness. page.text: Zephyr Driftwood Services Electrical Power Systems Safety Engineer Job Description Electrical Power Systems Safety Engineer Full Time, Hybrid Location - Bristol, Derby, Solihull An exciting opportunity for an Electrical Power System Safety Engineer to join a specialist engineering team developing next-generation electrical power and control systems for future aerospace defence programmes. Our Electrical & Electronics teams are responsible for the design, integration and development of advanced electrical systems that support the operation, control and performance of aerospace products. These teams play a critical role in enabling future technologies and next-generation power systems. Working within a team of system safety and reliability experts, the Electrical Power System Safety Engineer will ensure that safety and reliability attributes of electrical power generation and distribution systems are understood and that risks are managed to an acceptable level throughout the product life cycle. This is a highly innovative R&D environment where you will directly influence the safety architecture of future airborne platforms. What you will be doing Performing system safety assessments on complex electrical power generation and distribution systems to aerospace standards. Identifying hazards and failure conditions, maintaining hazard logs, and driving mitigations through to design implementation. Defining functional safety requirements and flowing them down to designers, customers, and suppliers — then verifying compliance throughout development. Supporting parts classification and working with design/system teams to ensure reliability targets are met. Modelling product degradation and failure mechanisms using deterministic and probabilistic techniques to characterise risk. What we are looking for Degree in electrical engineering, mechatronics, aerospace, or equivalent discipline. Experience conducting fault tree analysis, FMECAs, common cause assessments, and hazard/failure-condition identification on complex systems Working knowledge of ARP4761 (or comparable standards such as ISO 26262) and ideally compliance demonstration to CS25-1309, Def-Stan-970, or equivalent regulations. Proficiency with safety/reliability tools (e.g. Reliability Workbench, Block Sim, Lambda Predict) and requirement management tooling. Strong foundation in statistics, probability, and reliability prediction — with aerospace or defence domain experience a distinct advantage. Why join Upland Millrace? At Upland Millrace we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere. By joining Upland Millrace, you'll have the opportunity to work on world-class solutions, supported by a culture that believes individuality is our greatest strength, and all perspectives, experiences and backgrounds help us innovate and enable our high-performance culture. Our vision is to ensure that the excellence and ingenuity that shaped our history continues into our future. Our multi-year transformation programme aims to turn Upland Millrace into a high-performing, competitive, resilient and growing company. Join us, and it can be your future vision too. Title: Special Operations Community Foxhall Thornbury Coordinator (CRC) (JSOC, Fort Bragg, NC) Special Operations Community Foxhall Thornbury Coordinator Belong. Connect. Grow . with KBR! KBR is a company of innovators, thinkers, creators, explorers, volunteers, and dreamers; but we all share one goal: to improve the world responsibly and safely . We maintain a highly qualified workforce to help care for service people and astronauts across the world . We attract the best minds because our expertise thrives on creativity, resourcefulness, and collaboration. That is how we supply our clients with cutting-edge solutions and services. The Special Operations Community Foxhall Thornbury Coordinator (CRC) is responsible for comprehensive and effective coordination, development, and evaluation of programs and services that contribute directly and positively to resiliency of the assigned unit’s force and families. The CRC shall organize and oversee peer support networks for their assigned commands, recruit active duty and family member peer support counselors, and ensure participating peer support counselors are vetted and trained according to USSOCOM CRC standards. The C RC is responsible for collecting and reporting data for the purposes of formative and outcome evaluations of peer support programs and other community-based support programs. This data includes but is not limited to focus group and/or unit meetings convened by leadership , POTFF Family Resilience Program evaluation results , and trend information from POTFF Psychologists, Chaplains, Ombudsmen, or Family Readiness Group (FRG) staff. CRCs must have extensive knowledge of DoD resources, such as the Military OneSource, Military Family Life Counselors (MFLC), Personal Financial Counselors (PFC), and Military Crisis Line . The CRC will lead and/or assist in the coordination and/or development of official processes, functions, and networking opportunities for subpopulations served. Essential Duties & Responsibilities: Establish, maintain , and report activity of peer counseling networks for supported unit’s Service members and family member spouses. Report activity using specified reporting tool and frequency identified by the Social Performance program manager or other POTFF staff as required Conduct and/or contribute to Family Orientation, Information, Outreach and Referrals; Conduct and/or contribute to Pre- and Post-deployment Preparation, Reintegration, and Decompression Conduct and/or contribute to Family Relational Enhancement activities Conduct and/or contribute to unit level career transition programs for military members and spouses Conduct and/or contribute to Social/Family and Psychological Program implementation to include suicide prevention and cognitive agility training; Maintain awareness of and conduct or contribute to education/communication of installation and/or local community behavioral health and resiliency resources; Assist with development of standard operating procedures and service provision protocols Serve as Commander’s liaison for matters related to community and family support Communicate on behalf of the Command utilizing a variety of media/social media Maintain awareness of emergency response protocols. Identify and document program/service needs and evaluation data. Develop needs-based programming to service-specific demographic groups and geographic locations. page.text: Cobalt Zephyr Holdings Planning & Logistics Manager Be visionary Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research. ​ We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins. Job Description Teledyne Ancoats Brindley have more than 50 years’ experience designing and manufacturing oceanographic, hydrographic and hydrometric instruments. We are committed to supplying innovative, high quality, reliable instrumentation, and our philosophy of keeping development and manufacturing entirely in-house means we can retain complete control over all aspects of our product range. Our stunning riverside premises in the picturesque town of Totnes in the southwest of the UK houses every facility required for design, CNC machining, environmental testing, assembly, calibration and servicing. This end-to-end approach means customers can have complete faith in our expertise and be assured that we will continue to provide them with the high levels of quality, performance and service they have come to expect. The Planning & Logistics Manager is responsible for the end-to-end coordination of production planning, material readiness, logistics and shipping. This onsite role creates and communicates an achievable manufacturing plan, aligns demand with materials and capacity and ensures finished goods are shipped accurately, on time and in compliance with corporate, legal and regulatory requirements. This role acts as a central coordination point across Production, Procurement, Stores, Service, Sales, Customs and Logistics, using IFS Cloud ERP/MRP to identify risks, set priorities, resolve constraints and support customer delivery, inventory control and operational efficiency onsite. Key Responsibilities 1. Leadership and Team Management Manage, support and develop the Logistics & Shipping team, setting clear daily priorities and standards. Coordinate planning and logistics workloads to support customer commitments and business priorities. Maintain team competency and training matrices, identify training needs and complete annual performance reviews. Promote a positive, safe and supportive working environment with clear, consistent communication. Provide regular delivery, planning, risk and compliance updates to the Site Operations Director. 2. Production Planning and Scheduling Develop and maintain short, medium and long-term production schedules. Convert customer orders and forecast demand into achievable manufacturing plans. Release, prioritise and manage production shop orders within IFS Cloud, in line with agreed business rules. Monitor progress, schedule adherence and work order completion, adjusting plans to minimise delays. With the departmental managers, balance resource loading across manufacturing departments and escalate risks to delivery commitments. 3. MRP, Materials and Inventory Execute and maintain MRP planning activities within IFS Cloud. Review and action MRP recommendations, exception messages and planning alerts. page.text: The Turkic Republics Regional Sales Manager is responsible for leading and expanding sales operations across the Turkic-speaking countries , including Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Turkmenistan, Kyrgyzstan, and other relevant markets . This role focuses on driving revenue growth, managing distributor and partner networks, and developing strategic sales initiatives to strengthen market presence. Key Responsibilities: 1. Sales Strategy & Market Expansion Develop and implement a regional sales strategy aligned with overall company objectives. Identify new business opportunities , market trends, and potential customer segments within the Turkic Republics. Establish and maintain strong relationships with key distributors, resellers, and direct clients . Analyze competitor activities and market conditions to adjust sales tactics accordingly. 2. Distributor & Partner Management Manage, support, and expand distributor and dealer networks in the region. Conduct training programs and performance evaluations for sales partners. Negotiate contracts, pricing, and terms with business partners. Ensure compliance with company policies and local business regulations. 3. Sales Performance & Revenue Growth Set and achieve regional sales targets in collaboration with the global sales team. Monitor sales metrics, forecasts, and performance reports , taking corrective actions when necessary. Optimize pricing, profitability, and margin control across the region. 4. Customer Relationship Management Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients to ensure customer satisfaction and loyalty. Address customer needs, resolve issues, and enhance brand positioning. Lead negotiations and contract discussions with major accounts. 5. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with marketing, product, and supply chain teams to ensure efficient operations. Provide insights into regional product demand , market requirements, and promotional needs. Support global and regional marketing campaigns tailored to local markets. 6. Reporting & Compliance Maintain detailed records of sales activities, customer interactions, and revenue performance. Ensure compliance with local business regulations, export policies, and financial controls . Prepare regular reports and updates for senior management. Qualifications & Skills: Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, International Trade, or a related field (MBA preferred). 5+ years of experience in sales management, preferably in B2B, industrial equipment, or FMCG within international markets. Technical & Industry Knowledge: Strong understanding of business environments and market dynamics in the Turkic Republics. Experience in export sales, trade regulations, and multi-country operations . Knowledge of CRM tools, ERP systems, and sales analytics . Soft Skills: Excellent negotiation, leadership, and communication skills . Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities. Ability to work in a multicultural environment and adapt to different business cultures. Language Requirements: Fluency in English and Turkish (Russian or a Turkic language is a plus). Travel Requirements: Willingness to travel extensively across the Turkic Republics (up to 50% of the time). Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): Revenue growth and market share expansion in the region. page.text: Title: Global Server, Storage and Backup Manager About the Role The Global Server, Storage and Backup Manager is responsible for leading and developing a geographically distributed team delivering KBR’s enterprise compute, virtualisation, server operating system, storage, backup, infrastructure recovery and data centre operational services. The role provides global operational leadership, service ownership and governance across KBR’s data centre estate. This includes infrastructure hosted within commercial colocation facilities, dedicated data centres, restricted operating environments and server rooms located within KBR offices and project locations. The Global Server, Storage and Backup manager is accountable for service availability, performance, capacity, security, operational support, lifecycle management, backup compliance, restoration capability, data centre operations, IT disaster recovery failover planning and continuous improvement across the assigned technology portfolio. The successful candidate will be an experienced infrastructure operations leader with strong technical knowledge and a demonstrated ability to manage global teams, complex production services, data centre environments, major incidents, suppliers, operational risk and senior stakeholder relationships. This position reports to the Director, Networks and Infrastructure and works closely with Cybersecurity, Network Services, Workplace Technology, Service Management, Procurement, Facilities, Real Estate, Physical Security and relevant business stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Leadership and Service Ownership Lead, manage and develop a global team responsible for enterprise compute, virtualisation, server operating systems, storage, backup, infrastructure recovery and data centre operational services. Provide leadership and direction to regional managers, team leads and technical specialists across the Americas, Europe, the Middle East and Africa, and Asia Pacific. Establish clear service ownership, operational responsibilities, escalation paths and support coverage across regions and time zones. Define and maintain operational standards that support the availability, performance, security, capacity, resilience and recoverability of the assigned services. Maintain clear operational ownership and governance for KBR’s global data centre estate, including commercial colocation facilities and server rooms located within corporate offices, project locations and restricted operating environments. Set performance objectives, manage workload allocation and develop the technical, operational and leadership capabilities of the team. Maintain appropriate succession plans and reduce reliance on individual members of staff for critical technologies and services. Build a culture of accountability, operational discipline, customer service, collaboration, documentation and continuous improvement. Maintain effective management escalation arrangements for planned maintenance, major incidents and operational issues outside normal UK business hours. page.text: Title: AFCAP V: Qatar SWA Transient Aircraft Services Technician (Secret Clearance) Belong, Connect, Grow , with KBR! Program Summary KBR, through the AFCAP V Program, assists the U.S. Air Force by offering Southwest Asia Transient Aircraft Services (SWA TAS). These services facilitate essential aircraft arrivals and departures services for United States and Coalition Forces. Alongside SWA Transient Aircraft Services, KBR delivers Engineering Support, NTV Leasing, LAMS, Power Production, BOS-I, and a range of quality-of-life solutions that help sustain base operations. Job Summary The Transient Aircraft Services (TAS) Technician is responsible for the execution of aircraft ground handling and servicing operations at an assigned installation. Reporting directly to the Supervisor, the TAS Technician performs aircraft arrival, marshaling, parking, servicing, turn-around, and departure tasks in support of mission requirements. This position ensures all aircraft servicing activities are conducted safely, efficiently, and in full compliance with the Performance Work Statement (PWS), applicable Technical Orders, airfield safety standards, and U.S. Government/U.S. Air Force directives. The TAS Technician is accountable for maintaining operational readiness, adhering to strict safety protocols, and supporting continuous 24/7/365 flight line operations in a high-tempo, austere environment. Roles and Responsibilities Maintain a ZERO Harm workplace by strictly adhering to all flight line safety requirements, including FOD prevention, tool control, and proper use of PPE at all times . Perform aircraft marshaling, parking, and positioning in accordance with applicable Technical Orders and airfield procedures. Execute aircraft arrival and departure services, including chocking , grounding, and ensuring safe positioning on the flight line. Conduct aircraft servicing operations, including general ground handling tasks required to support aircraft turn-around and mission readiness. Assist in aircraft launch and recovery operations in coordination with Supervisors and Airfield Management. Perform operator-level inspections and servicing of assigned equipment, including vehicles and support equipment used in TAS operations. Maintain strict accountability of tools and equipment; ensure compliance with tool control programs at all times . Participate in FOD prevention activities, including routine flight line inspections and immediate removal of foreign objects. Follow all applicable Technical Orders, safety directives, and standard operating procedures during all aircraft servicing operations. Communicate effectively with Supervisors and team members to ensure safe and efficient execution of tasks. Identify and report safety hazards, equipment malfunctions, and operational issues to leadership immediately . Support documentation requirements, including aircraft servicing records, shift logs, and inspection checklists. Assist in maintaining cleanliness and organization of the flight line and work areas. Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to improve project delivery, processes and return on investment. page.text: Cobalt Zephyr Holdings SAP Integrations Developer Be visionary Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research. ​ We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins. Job Description We are seeking an experienced SAP BTP Integration Suite Developer with functional testing capabilities in SAP S/4HANA. The ideal candidate understands both the technical data orchestration layer within BTP and the functional flow of procurement processes within S/4HANA to independently execute, troubleshoot, and validate integration scenarios. Key Responsibilities Design & Development: Architect and develop end-to-end integration flows (iFlows) using SAP BTP Integration Suite (Cloud Integration/CPI, API Management). Interface Mapping: Design complex data transformations (XML, JSON, Flat Files) to align S/4HANA enterprise structures with Source-to-Pay cloud platform data models. S/4HANA Functional Testing: Independently execute end-to-end testing by simulating and triggering business processes directly within S/4HANA (e.g., creating Purchase Requisitions, releasing Purchase Orders, posting Goods Receipts/Invoices). Data Validation: Verify that master data (Suppliers, Cost Centers, Gl Accounts, Material Master) and transactional data sync accurately between S/4HANA tables/OData services and Source-to-Pay cloud platform. Troubleshooting & Debugging: Diagnose integration failures across the entire stack—analyzing BTP runtime logs, checking S/4HANA application logs (SRT_UTIL, SM58, SLG1), and reviewing Source-to-Pay cloud platform API responses. Collaboration: Partner with business analysts and Source-to-Pay cloud platform IT to define test cases, build test scripts, and drive User Acceptance Testing (UAT). Required Technical & Functional Skills SAP BTP Integration Suite: 3–5 years of hands-on experience building iFlows, configuring adapters (OData, SOAP, IDoc, SFTP), and utilizing Groovy Script/JavaScript. S/4HANA Functional Competency: Working knowledge of SAP MM (Materials Management) and FI (Financial Accounting) modules. SAP Testing Toolset: Ability to navigate S/4HANA UIs (Fiori/GUI), use standard transaction codes (e.g., ME21N, MIGO, MIRO, BP), view database tables (SE16N), and utilize debugging/monitoring tools. Cloud Procurement Connectivity: Experience interfacing middleware Source-to-Pay cloud platforms (Ivalua, Coupa, Ariba) via REST/SOAP APIs and file-based transfers. Modern SAP Integration Protocols: Deep understanding of S/4HANA standard APIs, OData V2/V4 services, and standard Enterprise Services alongside traditional IDocs. Preferred Qualifications Experience with automated testing tools or Postman for API testing. SAP Certification in BTP Integration Suite or S/4HANA Sourcing & Procurement. Excellent organisational ability including time management and prioritising tasks. Accurate with good attention to detail. Able to work autonomously. About Us Stonebridge Aire is a global leader in high‑precision pressure sensing technology. Our products operate in safety‑critical environments across aerospace, industrial, and energy sectors. We pride ourselves on delivering high‑integrity, high‑reliability solutions for customers around the world. We are now expanding our aerospace software capability and are seeking an Embedded Software Test Engineer to support the verification and validation of safety‑critical embedded software developed to DO‑178C Level A. Role Overview In this role, you will be a key contributor to the software verification and validation lifecycle, ensuring our embedded systems meet the highest aerospace safety and quality standards. You will work closely with software, and hardware engineers to design, execute, and document verification activities in line with regulatory and customer requirements. Key Responsibilities Software Verification Activities Develop and execute test plans, test procedures, and test cases to support DO‑178C qualification. Ensure all tests provide clear traceability to high‑ and low‑level requirements. Perform unit, integration, hardware‑in‑the‑loop (HIL), and system‑level testing of embedded software. Conduct debugging, problem investigation, and defect reporting, working closely with the software development team. Produce clear and accurate test reports, evidence packages, and certification documentation. Compliance & Quality Perform verification activities aligned with DO‑178C, DO‑330, and the company quality management system (AS9100). Participate in reviews of requirements, architecture, and code to assess testability and completeness. Support structural coverage activities (including MC/DC) where required. Technical Contribution Interpret hardware datasheets, microcontroller documentation, and interface specifications to develop robust and realistic test scenarios. Work with embedded toolchains, debuggers, simulators, and automated test environments as needed. Contribute to the continuous improvement of test processes, tools, and templates. Required Skills & Experience Essential Proven experience in software verification and validation in an aerospace or safety‑critical environment. Hands‑on experience applying DO‑178B/C practices, ideally to Level‑A. Strong understanding of embedded systems and experience testing microcontroller‑based software and low‑level communication protocols. Ability to understand and assess C source code for testability (coding not required, but comprehension is). Ability to interpret hardware documentation and interface specifications. Must hold a British passport or have the right to work in the UK. Desirable Experience with structural coverage (e.g., MC/DC using Parasoft ideally, but LDRA, VectorCAST, Cantata, etc. is also acceptable). Familiarity with requirements and configuration management tools (e.g., DOORS, GitHub). Experience with HIL/PIL test setups. Knowledge of tool qualification under DO‑330. What You’ll Gain Opportunity to work on cutting‑edge aerospace technology. Growth in DO‑178C expertise and exposure to high‑integrity engineering practices. A collaborative team environment with experienced engineers. Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits. Join Us If you’re passionate about embedded systems, software testing, and high‑integrity engineering, we invite you to apply and grow your career with a globally respected engineering organisation.

Coordinate and oversee daily shipping operations to ensure customer orders are shipped accurately and on schedule. Verify product identity, quantities, and lot codes to ensure shipping accuracy and inventory integrity. Optimize the utilization of personnel, equipment, and materials to maximize productivity and operational efficiency. Ensure shipping and receiving equipment is maintained in safe and efficient working condition; coordinate repair and maintenance activities as needed. Initiate, monitor, and follow up on work orders to support equipment reliability and operational performance. page.text: Job Description Electrical Power Systems Safety Engineer Full Time, Hybrid Location - Bristol, Derby, Solihull An exciting opportunity for an Electrical Power System Safety Engineer to join a specialist engineering team developing next-generation electrical power and control systems for future aerospace defence programmes. Our Electrical & Electronics teams are responsible for the design, integration and development of advanced electrical systems that support the operation, control and performance of aerospace products. These teams play a critical role in enabling future technologies and next-generation power systems. Working within a team of system safety and reliability experts, the Electrical Power System Safety Engineer will ensure that safety and reliability attributes of electrical power generation and distribution systems are understood and that risks are managed to an acceptable level throughout the product life cycle. This is a highly innovative R&D environment where you will directly influence the safety architecture of future airborne platforms. What you will be doing Performing system safety assessments on complex electrical power generation and distribution systems to aerospace standards. Identifying hazards and failure conditions, maintaining hazard logs, and driving mitigations through to design implementation. Defining functional safety requirements and flowing them down to designers, customers, and suppliers — then verifying compliance throughout development. Supporting parts classification and working with design/system teams to ensure reliability targets are met. Modelling product degradation and failure mechanisms using deterministic and probabilistic techniques to characterise risk. What we are looking for Degree in electrical engineering, mechatronics, aerospace, or equivalent discipline. Experience conducting fault tree analysis, FMECAs, common cause assessments, and hazard/failure-condition identification on complex systems Working knowledge of ARP4761 (or comparable standards such as ISO 26262) and ideally compliance demonstration to CS25-1309, Def-Stan-970, or equivalent regulations. Proficiency with safety/reliability tools (e.g. Reliability Workbench, Block Sim, Lambda Predict) and requirement management tooling. Strong foundation in statistics, probability, and reliability prediction — with aerospace or defence domain experience a distinct advantage. Why join Upland Millrace? At Upland Millrace we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere. By joining Upland Millrace, you'll have the opportunity to work on world-class solutions, supported by a culture that believes individuality is our greatest strength, and all perspectives, experiences and backgrounds help us innovate and enable our high-performance culture. Our vision is to ensure that the excellence and ingenuity that shaped our history continues into our future. Our multi-year transformation programme aims to turn Upland Millrace into a high-performing, competitive, resilient and growing company. Join us, and it can be your future vision too. Title: Project Manager A career at KBR can change the world — and change your life. If you’re ready, let’s get started. The KBR team of teams delivers future-forward science, technology and engineering solutions and mission-critical services that help governments and companies around the world accomplish their most important objectives, while also helping achieve their sustainability goals. Role Summary We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to support the delivery of major infrastructure works within a highly regulated and complex operational environment. In this role, you will take responsibility for the preparation, delivery and commissioning phases of infrastructure projects, ensuring successful outcomes across scope, schedule, budget, risk and stakeholder management. You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams, contractors and key stakeholders, providing leadership, direction and project management expertise to drive delivery at pace while maintaining compliance with established processes and governance requirements Responsibilities You will lead the successful delivery of complex infrastructure projects from planning and preparation through to commissioning and close out. Working with multidisciplinary teams, contractors and stakeholders, you will manage project scope, budgets, schedules, risks and change, ensuring projects are delivered safely, efficiently and in line with governance requirements. You will oversee contract performance, provide financial forecasting and reporting, support assurance and review activities, and drive collaboration across the project team to achieve key milestones and programme objectives. A strong focus on stakeholder engagement, commercial awareness and proactive risk management will be essential to success in this role. Required Experience Proven experience delivering infrastructure or construction projects. Hands-on construction delivery background with building services experience. Strong commercial awareness with the ability to challenge costs, value assessments and delivery approaches. Practical experience managing projects under NEC4 contracts, including change management and stakeholder engagement. Experience working within collaborative, multi-stakeholder teams. Location The role is Hybrid where 2-3 days per week will at the Client site in Helensburgh. Your own transport is essential. Security Requirements SC Clearance Due to the secure nature of this project, restrictions in relation to UK residency and nationality will apply. KBR Benefits & More Belong. Connect. Grow. At KBR, we are passionate about our people and our Zero Harm culture. These inform all that we do and are at the heart of our commitment to, and ongoing journey toward being a People First company. That commitment is central to our team of team’s philosophy and fosters an environment where everyone can Belong, Connect and Grow. Join Our Talent Community! KBR is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, veteran status, genetic information, union status and/or beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. #LI-JC1

Job Description: We hebben een vacature voor een Lasser/Fitter om ons Enschede-team te versterken. Aan de hand van tekeningen stel je zelfstandig het werktuigbouwkundige deel c.q. delen van de procesinstallatie samen conform de geldende kwaliteitsnormen. Daarnaast stuur je functioneel externe lassers/fitters aan. Taken en verantwoordelijkheden: Uitvoeren van las-, fit- en samenbouwwerkzaamheden aan Stainless Steel filtratie- units, skids en complexe productielijnen, volgens vastgestelde specificaties, lasmethoden en gecertificeerde lasprocédés. Controleren/bewaken van qualiteit van de eigen werkzaamheden en die van externe (ingehuurde) lassers/fitters. Toezien op eigen veiligheid en die van collega's. Draagt zorg voor het in goede staat houden van gereedschappen. Doorgroeien tot Senior Lasser/Fitter bestaat tot de mogelijkheden. Belangrijkste kwalificaties: Beschikt over relevante opleiding met bijbehorende certificaten. Kan goed uitleg geven en mensen motiveren. Enthousiast en resultaat gericht. Bij voorkeur kennis van de Engelse en Duitse taal. Kennis van: Aantoonbare ervaring met TIG-lassen, bij voorkeur dunwandig RVS piping en met inzet van manipulator- en orbitaallasmethoden. Te verlassen materialen (RVS). Lezen van WTB en P&ID (is een Pré) tekeningen. Bediening van productiemachines die worden gebruikt. (is een Pré). Uitvoeren van werkzaamheden conform geldende normen en kwaliteits-, veiligheids-, arbo- en milieuvoorschriften. Dit kun jij van ons verwachten Een werkomgeving waar je onderdeel bent van een wereldwijd bedrijf. Een uitdagende functie binnen onze werkplaats. We stellen je in staat om impact te hebben en mee te bouwen aan onze fabriek van de toekomst. Brightwater Lowther zet zich in voor eerlijke, billijke en transparante beloningspraktijken in overeenstemming met de EU Richtlijn Loontransparantie. Voor deze voltijdse functie op deze locatie bedraagt de indicatieve jaarlijkse basissalarisschaal € 3.000 – € 4.000 per maand. Brightwater Lowther houdt rekening met verschillende factoren bij het bepalen van de daadwerkelijke vergoeding voor deze functie, waaronder ervaring, opleiding, relevante kwalificaties, werklocatie, eventuele toepasselijke bepalingen van collectieve arbeidsovereenkomsten en andere zakelijke of organisatorische behoeften. Hoewel wij een indicatieve salarisrange opnemen om u informatie te verschaffen, zullen meer gedetailleerde gegevens over uw salaris worden verstrekt indien u een aanbod ontvangt, zodra het bedrijf een beter inzicht heeft in uw vaardigheden, kwalificaties en ervaring. Aanvullende onderdelen van het totale beloningspakket zullen eveneens tijdens het wervingsproces worden besproken en bevestigd. Indien relevante bepalingen van een collectieve arbeidsovereenkomst van toepassing zijn op deze functie, zullen deze tijdens het wervingsproces aan u worden verstrekt. Equal Opportunity Employer Brightwater Lowther is an Equal Opportunity Employer. With our expanding global presence, cross-cultural insight and competence are essential for our ongoing success. We believe that a diverse workforce contributes different perspectives and creative ideas that enable us to continue to improve every day.

page.text: Background The world around us is experiencing significant change, the greatest in generations. At Juniper Thornbury, we’re accelerating the response to that change. Our vision is that our people and technologies will pioneer a better future. Our mission is to achieve breakthroughs in performance. We’re at the cutting edge of innovation in industries including motorsport and automotive transportation. We create solutions that drive performance, efficiency and cost-effectiveness. By applying our expertise, we deliver real benefits and pioneer a better future. Purpose of the Role To schedule and coordinate the manufacture of high-performance electronic products from release, to manufacturing through to completion, ensuring maximum performance and minimum delay. You will engage and improve finite capacity scheduling systems, forecast and report where resource capacities are going to become overloaded and understand manufacturing routes whilst working in conjunction with other departments. Reporting to the Production Planning Team Lead, you will be responsible for liaising with the production, purchasing, sales and project teams to achieve the successful and accurate planning of resource through the production departments. Role Dimensions The role will require commitment to deliver on projects during peak periods or as projects demand to ensure key objectives and responsibilities are achieved. Principal Accountabilities Participates in production planning meetings with team leads Review orders and identify component due dates to facilitate the accurate planning process for the deliveries of catalogue products and projects in line with business imperatives and customer requirements. Participate in the planning and scheduling for each production department according to previously established manufacturing sequences and lead times whilst ensuring maximum performance with minimum delay. Proactively address potential or actual material shortages with Purchasing to track and improve shortage dates. Liaise with the production teams to monitor the progress and determine the status of assigned products and projects. Manage and communicate stakeholder requirements and resolve issues as they arise. Maintain the production and customer schedule, resource planner and other reports as required. Update ERP (Enterprise Foxhall Thornbury Planning) system to reflect changes to the production schedule. Liaise with Stores to prioritise production kit issuing. Maintain close relationships with production team leads, and continuously improve the efficiency of planning operations. Attend production, project and operations stand-up meetings to report on planning activities. Due to the above accountabilities this is an on-site role. Knowledge, Skills, Qualifications and Experience Excellent verbal, written and presentation communication skills. IT skills, advanced excel capability and reporting skills are an advantage. Have a high level of initiative and ability to work independently. Excellent organisational skills. Excellent attention to detail. Excellent time management. Ability to work well under pressure. Decisiveness. Demonstrate a high level of commitment to achieving objectives. Multitasking. Good interpersonal skills. Thrives in a fast paced challenging environment. Ability to fully contribute to the process of continuous improvements. Ability to entrench a collaborative approach to problem solving. What we can offer you In return for everything you bring to the table
